ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 30:70 ratio of high-intensity white (distal lobes) to low-intensity black (central and peduncle regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black mass extending from the peduncle to the median notch. Right distal lobe contains a contiguous white patch (approx. 20% of lobe surface) with circular black spots. Left distal lobe contains a white patch (approx. 15% of surface) with diffuse mottling at the proximal boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree interior angle and a depth of roughly 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire span. Notable deep notch (approx. 40 pixels deep) located on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from distal tips to median notch, significantly modulated by serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Five distinct circular black focal spots arranged curvilinearly on the right lobe's white distal patch. High-intensity yellowish-white pixel clusters at both lateral tips indicating barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant traumatic indentation/missing tissue section on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized barnacle clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, appearing as high-contrast irregular lumps.
